# TEdit Web map colors

Derived from [`src/utils/dbs/colors.js`](https://github.com/TEdit/terraria-map-editor-web/blob/17d60d01483ff3a7ad551c7b0eeba71fd4a23394/src/utils/dbs/colors.js) at revision `17d60d01483ff3a7ad551c7b0eeba71fd4a23394`. The retained local source and this upstream file have the same Git blob ID, `9446d934db42e5342de9c32e714db08a2fbe780b`.

Original project: https://github.com/TEdit/terraria-map-editor-web

Originally created by cokolele; maintained by the TEdit contributors. MIT; the full notice is included in `public/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt` under TEdit Web.

`palette.json` contains the RGB values for blocks, walls, liquids and background. For IDs with multiple frame-dependent colors, only the first color is used in this initial map overview. Game textures, paint, wiring, lighting and slopes are not reproduced by this palette.
